value: I have been a data engineer for six years, first in logistics at Brindille Logistique, then in energy at Ventolune Énergie. At Brindille Logistique, I built the delivery-time forecast used by 120 warehouses, which is close to the pipelines behind your delivery-time estimates. At Ventolune Énergie, I cut the nightly pipeline from 6 hours to 40 minutes with incremental loads, and I want to bring that work on reliable pipelines to Lavande Freight.
At Brindille Logistique, where I worked as a data engineer, I built the delivery-time forecast. This forecast was used by 120 warehouses.
